description:
If you’re thinking about it, don’t act—yet.
That single pause can change everything.
In moments of overthinking, urgency, or inner restlessness, most of us assume our thoughts need immediate action. This talk explores why that instinct often leads us astray, and how learning to pause can turn mental noise into clarity.
Rather than treating anxiety as something to eliminate, this talk reframes it as a powerful source of energy. When recognised early, tamed gently, and redirected deliberately, that same restless drive can become focus, discipline, and better decision-making.
Through real-life experiences and a simple framework - Recognise. Tame. Redirect. (RTR), this talk offers a practical way to create space between thought and action. Over time, that space becomes a skill. And with practice, it becomes a form of mental discipline.
Anxiety isn’t the enemy. Reaction is.

What if the very thing you think disqualifies you is the reason you’ll win?

At 17, Timothy Armoo had no network, no capital, and no credentials; only a phone, a brain, and the audacity to ask differently. Years later, that same mindset would help him scale a company to 80 employees, work with global brands, and secure multi eight-figure exits.

In this candid talk, Timothy pulls back the curtain on the internal psychology of high growth. Through personal journal entries never meant for public eyes, he reveals how embracing ignorance, inventing an alter ego, and reframing setbacks allowed him to move through fear, and outwork self-doubt, instead of waiting for it to disappear.

This talk challenges the mythology of overnight success and replaces it with something far more practical: structured self-belief built through action.

In this deeply personal and powerful talk, Maggie explores the four forms of audacity that shaped her life: the audacity to begin, to learn, to lead, and ultimately to let go. 

From scaling Pepsi production in Uganda from five million to one hundred million crates, to serving as Executive Director of the Uganda Investment Authority for over a decade, her journey reflects the intersection of private enterprise and national transformation.

This talk is a masterclass in fearless reinvention; and a reminder that leadership is often claimed before it feels earned.

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Africa does not lack intelligence. It lacks resilience.

In a continent constantly defined by adversity; youth unemployment, policy gaps, capital constraints, Patrick Bitature argues that success requires more than IQ or even EQ. 

It requires RQ: the Resilience Quotient.

In this powerful and deeply personal talk, Patrick traces his journey from losing his father under the regime of Idi Amin to becoming one of East Africa’s most influential business leaders. 

From smuggling sugar as a teenager to founding the Simba Group, from building Uganda’s largest telecom distribution network to investing in power generation and infrastructure, his life is a study in endurance.

Through raw, honest stories; losing millions in Nigeria, rebuilding from zero after marriage, risking everything to open a nightclub in 30 days, Patrick reframes failure as training. 

He introduces a three-part formula: build your IQ, refine your EQ, but cultivate your RQ relentlessly.

title: The Resilience Quotient (RQ) | Patrick Bitature | TEDxMakerere University Business School

Mariana Plum nos desafia a olhar para a Amazônia além do mito, revelando que a proteção da floresta não é apenas uma causa ambiental, mas uma infraestrutura crítica essencial para a economia, a segurança e o desenvolvimento sustentável do Brasil. Mariana é uma pensadora da segurança nacional. Doutora em Relações Internacionais pela PUC do Rio de Janeiro, a acadêmica tem um longo histórico de atuação no setor de defesa. Nos últimos dez anos, ela foi assessora do Ministro da Defesa, assessora-técnica do Gabinete de Segurança Institucional, coordenadora de pesquisa no Centro de Estudos Estratégicos do Exército, professora da Escola Superior de Guerra e, desde 2022, atua também como consultora internacional do Institute for Defense Analyses.
